graph_partition.policy: fixed dataset-independent scheduler occupancy cap below one physical ping-pong half
graph_partition.source: HyGCN Section 4.3.2 requires the destination interval and its aggregation results to fit the on-chip Aggregation Buffer; the paper does not publish the simulator's interval occupancy, so this request-level model reports the fixed scheduler cap separately from the 16 MiB physical capacity
graph_partition.calibration_disclosure: changed from the review-v3 implicit 4 MiB value and covered by 4/5/6 MiB sensitivity evidence

memory_ablation.row_first_source: The review-v3 baseline used kUncoordinatedBankInterleave=2. This version preserves that baseline value for comparability but moves it into configuration and reports it explicitly. DRAMSim3 enables a second HBM command per cycle when read/write classes differ; the two-bank striping is only a request-level width approximation, not a claim that DRAMSim3 pairs adjacent banks.
memory_ablation.row_first_layout_basis: configs/HBM1_4Gb_x128.ini uses address_mapping=rorabgbachco; the request-level row-first baseline preserves full-row locality before distributing rows across channels and reports the collapsed mapping formula in source and tests
memory_ablation.low_bits_source: HyGCN HPCA 2020 Section 4.5.2: channel and bank identifiers use lower address bits

scope_limits: request-level model rather than Ramulator or RTL cycle accuracy
